extra_vocab.en: the act of finding an answer by using numbers
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於財務、預算、採購與工程情境，指算出數字的過程或結果。常說 make a calculation、check the calculation。

example.en: Her calculations were checked by two different managers.
example.zh: 她的計算由兩位不同的經理檢查過。

example.en: Please make a calculation of the total shipping cost first.
example.zh: 請先算出總運費。

example.en: A rough calculation suggests profits will rise by ten percent.
example.zh: 粗略估算顯示利潤將成長百分之十。

example.en: A calculation error caused the invoice to show the wrong total.
example.zh: 一個計算錯誤使發票上的總額不正確。

examples.en: The accountant checked each calculation before sending the report.
examples.zh: 會計在寄出報告前檢查了每一筆計算。

examples.en: Our calculation shows that we need three more workers.
examples.zh: 我們的計算顯示還需要三名員工。

examples.en: According to my calculations, the order will cost under five thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 依我的計算，這筆訂單的費用不到五千美元。

similar.diff: estimate 是大約的估計或估價；calculation 強調用數字算出來的過程。

example.en: Please send me an estimate for the repair work.
example.zh: 請寄一份維修工程的估價單給我。

example.en: The total on the bill was higher than expected.
example.zh: 帳單上的總額比預期的高。

example.en: The sales figure for May is better than last year.
example.zh: 五月的銷售數字比去年好。

example.en: Use this formula to find the monthly cost.
example.zh: 用這個公式算出每月的費用。

derived.link: calculate 是基礎字；calculate + -ion，動詞變名詞，像 educate → education

senses.en: the work of finding an answer with numbers

example.en: The calculation took only a few minutes with the new software.
example.zh: 用新軟體計算只花了幾分鐘。

senses.en: careful thinking about what will probably happen
senses.distinguish: 後面接 risk、cost 或出現 careful 時，指謹慎評估，不一定是數字計算。

example.en: After careful calculation, we chose the cheaper supplier.
example.zh: 經過仔細盤算後，我們選了比較便宜的供應商。

extra_vocab.en: to make something easier to understand
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於會議、電子郵件與客服對話，用來請對方把模糊的部分說清楚，或自己補充說明。語氣客氣、正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: clarify 是及物動詞，直接接受詞：clarify the policy，不加 about；也可接 what 等子句。

example.en: This table clarifies how bonuses are calculated each quarter.
example.zh: 這張表說明了每季獎金是怎麼計算的。

example.en: She clarified the schedule and everyone understood the plan.
example.zh: 她說明清楚了時程，大家都了解這項計畫。

example.en: He spent the morning clarifying the contract terms with the lawyer.
example.zh: 他一早上都在和律師釐清合約條款。

example.en: Let me clarify one point before we move on.
example.zh: 在我們繼續之前，讓我釐清一點。

example.en: Please call the supplier to clarify the details of the delivery.
example.zh: 請打電話給供應商，釐清送貨的細節。

example.en: The manager spoke to staff to clarify the situation.
example.zh: 經理向員工說明了情況。

examples.en: Could you clarify what you mean by a flexible deadline?
examples.zh: 你可以說明一下你所謂彈性截止日是什麼意思嗎？

examples.en: I am writing to clarify the terms of our agreement.
examples.zh: 我寫這封信是想釐清我們協議的條款。

examples.en: The company issued a statement to clarify its new rules.
examples.zh: 公司發出聲明來說明新的規定。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，classify 是「分類」，不是「說明清楚」。

example.en: We classify all documents by department and date.
example.zh: 我們依部門與日期把所有文件分類。

similar.diff: explain 是一般的說明；clarify 針對模糊、有疑問的部分補充說清楚。

example.en: Please explain how the new system works.
example.zh: 請說明這套新系統怎麼運作。

similar.diff: make clear 較口語，後面常接 that 子句，強調讓對方確定明白。

example.en: Let me make clear that the offer ends on Friday.
example.zh: 讓我說清楚，這項優惠星期五截止。

example.en: Please confirm the meeting time by email.
example.zh: 請用電子郵件確認會議時間。

example.en: The guide explains each step in simple words.
example.zh: 這份指南用簡單的文字說明每個步驟。

example.en: Please specify the size and color you need.
example.zh: 請明確指出你需要的尺寸和顏色。

derived.link: clarify + -cation，動詞變名詞，像 identify → identification

extra_vocab.en: to work together with other people to reach the same goal
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於部門合作、配合調查或稽核，以及與廠商的合作關係。cooperate with + 人或單位 是最常見的用法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: cooperate 是不及物動詞，後面接 with + 人／單位，不能直接接受詞；也可寫成 co-operate。

example.en: Our supplier always cooperates when we change the delivery date.
example.zh: 我們更改交貨日期時，供應商總是配合。

example.en: Both departments cooperated to finish the report ahead of schedule.
example.zh: 兩個部門合作，提前完成了報告。

example.en: Thank you for cooperating with us during the busy season.
example.zh: 謝謝您在旺季期間配合我們。

example.en: We are happy to cooperate with local schools on this project.
example.zh: 我們很樂意在這個專案上與當地學校合作。

example.en: The company promised to cooperate fully with the audit team.
example.zh: 公司承諾全力配合稽核小組。

example.en: Marketing and sales cooperate closely to plan each campaign.
example.zh: 行銷與業務部門密切合作來規劃每次活動。

examples.en: Sales and design teams must cooperate to meet the deadline.
examples.zh: 業務與設計團隊必須合作才能趕上截止日。

examples.en: All staff are asked to cooperate during the safety inspection.
examples.zh: 安全檢查期間，所有員工都須配合。

examples.en: The two firms agreed to cooperate on a new product.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司同意合作開發新產品。

confusable.diff: operate 是「操作、營運」；cooperate 多了 co-（一起），是「合作」。

example.en: Our team will operate the new machine next week.
example.zh: 我們的團隊下週會操作新機器。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，corporate 是形容詞，意思是「公司的」。

example.en: The corporate office is moving to a new building.
example.zh: 公司總部要搬到新大樓。

similar.diff: collaborate 更強調一起創作、共同完成成果；cooperate 偏重配合與協力。

example.en: The two designers collaborate on every new package.
example.zh: 這兩位設計師合作設計每一款新包裝。

similar.diff: 意思相同，work together 較口語，cooperate 較正式。

example.en: We need to work together to solve this problem.
example.zh: 我們需要一起合作解決這個問題。

example.en: Good teamwork helped us finish the project early.
example.zh: 良好的團隊合作幫助我們提早完成專案。

example.en: Our partner in Japan will visit next month.
example.zh: 我們在日本的合作夥伴下個月會來拜訪。

example.en: Two staff members will assist you at the front desk.
example.zh: 兩位員工會在櫃台協助您。

derived.link: cooperate + -ion，動詞變名詞，像 educate → education

extra_vocab.en: a person or company that delivers documents or packages quickly
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於急件、合約文件、樣品的寄送。courier 強調快速、直接送到，常用 send by courier 表示用快遞寄送。

example.en: Several couriers were waiting outside the building for the parcels.
example.zh: 好幾位快遞員正在大樓外等著收包裹。

example.en: A courier service can deliver the package within two hours.
example.zh: 快遞服務可以在兩小時內送達包裹。

example.en: Please send the signed forms by courier to our head office.
example.zh: 請把簽好的表格用快遞寄到我們總公司。

example.en: The courier fee is added to your final bill.
example.zh: 快遞費會加到你的最終帳單裡。

examples.en: The courier will pick up the contract at four o'clock.
examples.zh: 快遞員會在四點來取合約。

examples.en: Your parcel was handed to a courier this morning.
examples.zh: 您的包裹今天早上已交給快遞員。

examples.en: We use a courier for urgent documents that must arrive tomorrow.
examples.zh: 必須明天送達的急件，我們會使用快遞。

examples.en: I asked the courier to deliver the samples to the hotel.
examples.zh: 我請快遞員把樣品送到飯店。

confusable.diff: carrier 是運輸公司的泛稱（貨運、航空）；courier 專指快速送件的人或公司。

example.en: Our carrier delivers heavy freight to ports across Asia.
example.zh: 我們的運輸業者把重型貨物運到亞洲各地的港口。

similar.diff: messenger 是送信或文件的人，常指在城市內或公司之間跑腿。

example.en: A messenger brought the documents to our office by noon.
example.zh: 一位信差在中午前把文件送到我們辦公室。

similar.diff: delivery person 泛指送貨的人，不一定是快遞公司的人員。

example.en: The delivery person left the box at the front desk.
example.zh: 送貨員把箱子留在櫃台。

example.en: The parcel should arrive at your office by Friday.
example.zh: 包裹應該會在星期五前送到你的辦公室。

example.en: Please sign for the package at the front desk.
example.zh: 請到櫃台簽收包裹。

example.en: Delivery takes two to three business days.
example.zh: 送貨需要兩到三個工作天。

senses.en: a person who takes documents or packages to people

example.en: The courier gave me a pen and asked for my signature.
example.zh: 快遞員給了我一支筆，請我簽名。

senses.en: a company that delivers documents and packages quickly
senses.distinguish: 前面有 a、the 且指公司名稱或服務時，是快遞公司，不是個別的送貨人。

example.en: We changed to a faster courier to cut delivery times.
example.zh: 我們改用速度更快的快遞公司來縮短送貨時間。

extra_vocab.en: the legal right to control who can copy or sell a work
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於出版、網站、影像與軟體相關的公告和合約，指作品的所有權利。常和 protected by copyright、copyright law 一起出現。

example.en: The company sold its copyrights to a larger publishing firm.
example.zh: 這家公司把它的版權賣給一家較大的出版公司。

example.en: She copyrights every design before showing it to clients.
example.zh: 她在向客戶展示之前，會替每個設計申請版權。

example.en: The firm copyrighted its logo and all its training manuals.
example.zh: 這家公司為它的標誌和所有訓練手冊取得了版權。

example.en: Copyrighted pictures cannot be used without the owner's permission.
example.zh: 受版權保護的圖片未經擁有者許可不能使用。

example.en: He is copyrighting the new software before the product launch.
example.zh: 他正在新產品上市前為這套新軟體申請版權。

example.en: Copyright law protects books, music, and software from being copied.
example.zh: 著作權法保護書籍、音樂和軟體不被複製。

example.en: This design is protected by copyright, so please do not copy it.
example.zh: 這個設計受版權保護，所以請不要複製。

example.en: You must ask the copyright holder for permission first.
example.zh: 你必須先向版權所有人取得許可。

examples.en: The photographer owns the copyright to all the images.
examples.zh: 這位攝影師擁有所有圖片的版權。

examples.en: Our lawyer is checking whether we violate any copyright.
examples.zh: 我們的律師正在檢查我們是否侵犯了任何版權。

examples.en: The copyright for this article belongs to the publisher.
examples.zh: 這篇文章的版權屬於出版社。

examples.en: The contract says the copyright will stay with the writer.
examples.zh: 合約註明版權仍歸作者所有。

confusable.diff: copywriter 是「廣告文案撰寫人」，是人；copyright 是權利。

example.en: The copywriter wrote the slogan for our new advertisement.
example.zh: 文案撰寫人為我們的新廣告寫了標語。

similar.diff: patent 是專利，保護新發明；copyright 保護書、音樂等創作作品。

example.en: We applied for a patent on the new machine.
example.zh: 我們為這台新機器申請了專利。

similar.diff: trademark 是商標，保護品牌名稱或標誌；copyright 保護作品本身。

example.en: The company registered its logo as a trademark.
example.zh: 這家公司把它的標誌註冊為商標。

example.en: You need written permission to use these photos.
example.zh: 使用這些照片需要書面許可。

example.en: The software license allows up to ten users.
example.zh: 這個軟體授權最多允許十位使用者。

example.en: The author gave us permission to print the chapter.
example.zh: 作者允許我們印出這個章節。

example.en: Who holds the copyright to this training video?
example.zh: 這部訓練影片的版權屬於誰？

example.en: We plan to copyright the manual before it goes on sale.
example.zh: 我們打算在手冊上市前為它取得版權。

extra_vocab.en: a tall machine that lifts and moves heavy things
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於建築工地、港口與工廠的描述，指搬運重物的起重機。圖片題中看到 crane，多半是工地或港口場景。

example.en: Two cranes were working at the shipyard on Monday morning.
example.zh: 星期一早上，兩台起重機在造船廠作業。

example.en: A tower crane stands beside the new office building.
example.zh: 一台塔式起重機立在新辦公大樓旁。

example.en: The crane operator waited for a signal before lifting the load.
example.zh: 起重機操作員等到信號才吊起貨物。

example.en: We rented a mobile crane to move the machine.
example.zh: 我們租了一台移動式起重機來搬運機器。

examples.en: A large crane lifted the steel beams onto the roof.
examples.zh: 一台大型起重機把鋼梁吊到屋頂上。

examples.en: Workers wear helmets when a crane is moving nearby.
examples.zh: 附近有起重機移動時，工人都會戴安全帽。

examples.en: The port bought a new crane to unload heavy containers.
examples.zh: 港口買了一台新起重機來卸下重型貨櫃。

examples.en: A crane will remove the old sign from the building tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天會有起重機把舊招牌從大樓上拆下。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，crate 是裝貨物的「板條箱」。

example.en: Each crate contains twenty boxes of printer paper.
example.zh: 每個板條箱裡有二十盒影印紙。

similar.diff: hoist 是較小型的升降裝置，常用於工廠或倉庫的小範圍吊運。

example.en: The hoist can lift small loads up to two floors.
example.zh: 這台升降機可以把小型貨物吊到兩層樓高。

similar.diff: forklift 是叉舉車，用來搬運棧板，主要在地面移動；crane 是向高處吊起。

example.en: A forklift moved the pallets into the warehouse.
example.zh: 一台叉舉車把棧板搬進倉庫。

example.en: Construction on the new factory starts next month.
example.zh: 新工廠的施工下個月開始。

example.en: Visitors must wear helmets at the building site.
example.zh: 訪客在工地必須戴安全帽。

example.en: The heavy equipment will arrive at the site on Monday.
example.zh: 重型設備星期一會送到工地。

senses.en: a tall machine that lifts and moves heavy things

example.en: The crane moved the container from the ship to the truck.
example.zh: 起重機把貨櫃從船上移到卡車上。

senses.en: a large bird with long legs and a long neck
senses.distinguish: 上下文出現 lake、bird、park 等字時指鳥；出現 lift、construction、site 時指機器。

example.en: A crane stood quietly beside the lake near our factory.
example.zh: 一隻鶴靜靜地站在我們工廠附近的湖邊。

extra_vocab.en: a piece of paper or a code that gives you a lower price
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於購物、促銷廣告與電子郵件通知，指可以折抵或享有優惠的憑證。常和 redeem、valid、expire 等字一起出現。

example.en: Customers collected coupons from the newspaper every Sunday morning.
example.zh: 顧客每個星期天早上都會從報紙上收集優惠券。

example.en: You can redeem a coupon at any branch of our store.
example.zh: 你可以在我們任何一家分店兌換優惠券。

example.en: Enter the coupon code at checkout to see the new price.
example.zh: 結帳時輸入優惠碼，就可以看到新價格。

example.en: She printed a discount coupon before going to the shopping center.
example.zh: 她在去購物中心之前，先印了一張折價券。

examples.en: Show this coupon at the register to get ten percent off.
examples.zh: 在收銀台出示這張優惠券可享九折。

examples.en: Every new member receives a coupon for a free coffee.
examples.zh: 每位新會員都會收到一張免費咖啡的優惠券。

examples.en: We sent you a coupon as a thank-you for your order.
examples.zh: 我們寄了一張優惠券給你，感謝你的訂購。

examples.en: The coupon is valid only until the end of this month.
examples.zh: 這張優惠券只到本月底有效。

similar.diff: voucher 常是可抵付一定金額或兌換商品的憑證；coupon 多半是折價優惠。

example.en: The hotel gave us a meal voucher for the delay.
example.zh: 飯店因為延誤給了我們一張餐券。

similar.diff: discount code 是網購用的折扣碼，不是紙本；coupon 紙本與線上都能指。

example.en: Use the discount code on your confirmation email.
example.zh: 請使用確認信上的折扣碼。

example.en: Members get a twenty percent discount on all items.
example.zh: 會員所有商品可享八折優惠。

example.en: The winter sale starts on Friday morning.
example.zh: 冬季特賣星期五早上開始。

example.en: You can ask for a refund within thirty days.
example.zh: 你可以在三十天內要求退款。

extra_vocab.en: needing a lot of money or causing a big loss
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於預算、採購與風險討論，指花費很大或要付出很高代價。比 expensive 更正式，常搭配 mistake、delay、repair。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: costly 雖然字尾是 -ly，但它是形容詞，不是副詞；放在名詞前或 be 動詞後。

example.en: Air freight is costlier than shipping goods by sea.
example.zh: 空運比海運更貴。

example.en: This is the costliest project our company has ever started.
example.zh: 這是我們公司有史以來花費最高的專案。

example.en: A costly mistake on the order form delayed the shipment.
example.zh: 訂單表格上一個代價高昂的錯誤延誤了出貨。

example.en: The costly repair used up most of our maintenance budget.
example.zh: 這次昂貴的維修用掉了我們大部分的維護預算。

example.en: A costly delay at customs forced us to cancel the event.
example.zh: 海關的延誤代價高昂，迫使我們取消了活動。

examples.en: Replacing the old machine would be too costly for us.
examples.zh: 換掉舊機器對我們來說花費太高了。

examples.en: Hiring more staff is costly, so we are waiting until spring.
examples.zh: 增聘人手花費很大，所以我們要等到春天。

examples.en: Television ads are costly for small companies.
examples.zh: 電視廣告對小公司來說很昂貴。

examples.en: Last-minute changes to flight tickets can be very costly.
examples.zh: 臨時更改機票可能會非常花錢。

confusable.diff: cost 是名詞或動詞（費用、花費）；costly 才是形容詞（昂貴的）。
confusable.usage: 不能說 It is cost；要說 It is costly，或用 cost 當動詞：It costs a lot。

example.en: The repair will cost about two hundred dollars.
example.zh: 這次維修大約要花兩百美元。

similar.diff: expensive 單純指價格高；costly 較正式，也可指要付出很大代價。

example.en: The restaurant near our office is too expensive.
example.zh: 我們辦公室附近的餐廳太貴了。

similar.diff: pricey 是口語說法，意思是有點貴。

example.en: The hotel is pricey, but the location is excellent.
example.zh: 這家飯店有點貴，但地點很棒。

example.en: We must keep the project within the budget.
example.zh: 我們必須把專案控制在預算內。

example.en: Travel expenses will be paid back next week.
example.zh: 差旅費下週會核銷。

example.en: We cannot afford a new office this year.
example.zh: 我們今年負擔不起新辦公室。

derived.link: cost 是基礎字；cost + -ly，變成形容詞「花費大的」，像 friend → friendly

example.en: Moving the factory to another city is a costly plan.
example.zh: 把工廠搬到另一個城市是一項花費很大的計畫。

senses.en: causing a big loss or a serious problem
senses.distinguish: 後面接 mistake、error、delay 時，強調造成的損失，不只是價格高。

example.en: Missing the deadline would be a costly error for us.
example.zh: 錯過截止日對我們來說會是代價慘重的失誤。
